clock: observation, receipt and resolution instants are pulse-absd-boot:sha256:<hex(sha256(boot id))> plus boot milliseconds floor(ticks*1193*3000/3579545); a different boot is a different clock

derivation.arithmetic: unsigned integers, 128-bit products, no floating point
derivation.capacity_frames: tracked_frames if no limit, else min(tracked_frames, allocation_limit)
derivation.headroom_frames: free_frames if no limit, else min(free_frames, allocation_limit - allocated_frames saturating at 0)

owner: ABSD platform; this is not an NQ-NG compiled profile and has no NQ profile digest
source: kernel syscall frame_stats (35): free_frames, allocated_frames, allocation_limit (u64::MAX = none), frame_bytes; read with interrupts disabled on the one CPU, so one exact allocator state; tracked usable frames only (below 256 MiB, minus boot reservations); the observing process's own frames count as allocated
validity_reason: an instantaneous allocator sample: every map and exit changes it, so support lapses one minute of receiver boot clock after receipt
